description: This file provides utility functions for mapping statuses and strings to colors, primarily used for visual consistency in dashboards. It includes functions for generating deterministic pastel colors from strings and mapping common status labels to theme colors.

methods.name: colorFromString
methods.description: Deterministically generates a pastel HSL color string from an input string, producing distinct hues for different strings.

methods.name: getStatusColor
methods.description: Maps a status string to a theme color, with fallbacks to deterministic colors for unknown statuses.
